**Pizzeria Al Cavallino in Leutasch**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Al Cavallino** in the heart of **Leutasch**, where authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the **Tirol** Alps. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this cozy spot offers freshly baked pizzas with regional ingredients, perfect for a relaxed meal after a day of hiking or skiing.

Try their signature **Pizza Margherita** or indulge in a hearty **Pizza Diavola**—both made with love and topped with the finest local produce. Pair your meal with a glass of crisp Italian wine or a refreshing **Radler** for the true alpine experience.

Whether you're craving a quick lunch or a leisurely dinner, **Pizzeria Al Cavallino** is your go-to for delicious, rustic Italian cuisine in the stunning **Tirol** countryside. Don’t forget to ask about their seasonal specials—sometimes featuring fresh **Speck** or **Kaiserschmarrn** for dessert!
